neighbours.label: A legal clause that disposes of a right or claim: waiving, releasing, disclaiming, barring or (also) retaining it (waive, non-compete, gag order, renounce, limitation of liability, retain the right to a jury trial)
fire: The tenant hereby waives the right to a hearing before eviction.
Before the merger, every engineer signed a non-disclosure agreement.
By entering the race, you release the club from all claims for injury.
The seller disclaims all implied warranties of fitness for a purpose.
After the settlement, she relinquished any claim to the estate.
The union accepted a no-strike clause in exchange for higher pay.
A confidentiality order prevents the parties from discussing the case publicly.
Nothing in this agreement shall be construed as a waiver of our moral rights.
quiet: The tenant must pay rent on the first day of each month.
Before the merger, every engineer received a new laptop.
By entering the race, you agree to wear the numbered bib provided.
The seller delivers the goods within ten working days.
After the funeral, she inherited the house and the garden.
The union elected a new treasurer at its annual meeting.
The court scheduled the hearing for the second week of March.
Nothing in the museum may be photographed with a flash.

predictions: Clauses that waive, release, disclaim, bar or confirm a right or claim reach 0.4-1.1, peaking on the operative word (waive, non-disclosure, release, disclaims, relinquished, no-strike, waiver). Legal or contractual sentences about payment, delivery, scheduling, inheritance or elections, with no right or claim at stake, stay under 0.2; 'you agree to wear the bib' is the closest near miss and may reach about 0.15.
short: legal clause on a right or claim
notes: Probe: non-compete 1.100 (peak 'ete'), waive 1.036, renounce 0.610, gag order 0.567, limitation of liability 0.442; 'retain their right to a jury trial' 0.513 (peak ' retain') shows the pole tracks the right-or-claim object rather than only its surrender; 'grants full ownership' 0.294, 'confirm your attendance' 0.145, 'granted permission to travel' 0.016, garden 0.010. Card: LIMIT|ATION of liability, legal dis|claimers, Non-Compet|e, Arbit|ration, ' waive' x3, ' gag', ren|ounce (max 41.5, layer 12); the output promotes ' contractual', ' compensation', ' clauses', ' indemn'.
